name: log_scaling_tau
description: Per-leading-row scaling: out=(x.float()*tau.reshape(rows,1,...)).to(x.dtype), where rows=x.shape[0] and tau has one value per row. x may be 2-D or higher-dimensional; tau is not broadcast beyond the leading dimension. Returns a new tensor with x's shape. Current tests exercise float16 with shapes (1,128), (37,8,64), (129,512) and (T,16,128) for T 1..8192.
